prompt: Single continuous shot, no cuts. A large roasting tray — chicken pieces over potatoes and onions — sliding into the oven, oil glistening. The camera follows a long table being dressed in wide motions: a tablecloth billowing open in the air, plates gliding into place, glasses set in rhythm. Money shot: the golden roasted tray landing at the center of the crowded table, backlit steam rising as several hands reach in to serve at once. Final beat: her seat at the table, seated and laughing, glass in hand — part of the lunch, not trapped in the kitchen. Warm Sunday light, film grain. Dominant sound: the billowing cloth, then the tray landing. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
caption:
O teste do bom almoço de domingo: quem cozinhou conseguiu SENTAR?

Planejado desde quinta, assado que se cuida sozinho, e ela na mesa — onde sempre deveria estar.

Manda pra quem recebe a família todo domingo 👇
